description: List blog posts for a site. Filter by status (draft, published) with pagination support.

cursor.description: Accepted for compatibility; results are not paginated by cursor, so use limit.

domain.description: Site domain to scope this call to (e.g. example.com). Alternative to site_id.

limit.description: Max posts to return. Defaults to 50, capped at 200.

site_id.description: Site UUID to scope this call to. Alternative to domain.

status.description: Only posts with this status, e.g. "draft", "published" or "scheduled". Omit for all.

name: get_posts
title: Get Posts
